content.value: Differentiate between confined and unconfined aquifer. A 30 cm well completely (13) penetrates an unconfined aquifer of saturated depth 40m. After a long period of pumping at a steady rate of 1500 Ipm the drawdown in two observation wells 25 m and 75 m from the pumping well were found to be 3.5 m and 2.0 m, respectively. Determine the transmissivity of the aquifer. What is the drawdown of the pumping well?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2015
